The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner- and edge-sharing between Dy and Fe polyhedra, corner-sharing between Dy polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Fe polyhedra.
